description: Count business (working) days between two dates, or add/subtract N business days from a date, skipping weekends and given holidays. Give end to count, or days to add (negative to go back). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

include_end.description: Count the end date, default true

include_start.description: Count the start date, default true
